description: This file defines a Flutter screen widget for displaying and editing user profile information. It includes providers for profile data, and contains UI components for displaying user name and email, as well as actions for saving changes and signing out.

classes.name: ProfileScreen
classes.description: A Flutter widget representing the profile screen, which displays user information and allows editing and sign out.

classes.name: _ProfileScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the profile screen state, including profile data fetching, editing, and actions.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Performs the profile update by calling the repository method, updates the UI accordingly, and handles errors.
